query:
INSERT INTO mcp_sessions
SET
  token = ?,
  private_session_token = ?,
  private_refresh_token = ?,
  user_token = ?,
  maybe_mcp_client_name = ?,
  maybe_mcp_client_version = ?,
  maybe_mcp_client_vendor = ?,
  ip_address_creation = ?,
  ip_address_update = ?,
  created_at = NOW(),
  expires_at = NOW() + INTERVAL ? DAY
